title: Sharp-chart local algebra in the prescribed strict henselization
statement: Let X be a locally Noetherian log regular fs log scheme [def-trf-fs-log-blowup, pqf-def-locnoeth] and let t:Spec(Omega)->X be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] over x. Put R=O_{X,x}, A=O^sh_{X,t} using the prescribed affine pointed-neighbourhood colimit [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], and write P additively for its characteristic monoid. Then P is sharp fs. There are a field K which is a separable closure of the residue field of R, compatible residue-field and R-algebra structures on K, and an R-algebra structure on A for which A is an algebraic strict henselization of R relative to K [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization]. There are local and Noetherian structures on A, a monoid map a:Multiplicative(P)->A, an ideal I and a natural number r with the following properties. Every nonzero p maps into m_A. For every monoid ideal J, including the empty ideal, a(p) lies in the ideal generated by a(J) iff p belongs to J. I is exactly the ideal generated by all a(p) for nonzero p. The natural number r is dim_Q(Q tensor_Z P^gp) [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], and every additive monoid isomorphism P=N^s forces r=s. The quotient A/I is regular local [def-weil-regular-scheme] and dim A=dim(A/I)+r [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Neither regularity of A nor freeness of P is a conclusion of this preparation lemma.

proof.text: Choose the affine pointed sharp characteristic chart. P is fs sharp. Compose the chart germ, log structural map and canonical strict-local colimit comparison to obtain a:P->A. A nonzero p has nonunit log image, hence nonunit ring image by reflection of units. In the local ring A this means membership in its maximal ideal.

proof.text: Choose the relative separable closure K of the ordinary residue field in Omega. An affine open about x identifies its ordinary stalk with the prime localization. The affine strict-local comparison, its small-colimit comparison and the canonical stalk/localization isomorphism give the asserted R-algebra structure and algebraic strict-henselization property. Local Noetherianity makes R Noetherian, and strict henselization makes A local Noetherian.

source.place: Expose VI, 1.4 and 1.7, printed pp. 69--70; Expose VIII, 3.4.4, printed p. 110, and 4.1.1, printed p. 117. Normal crossings here is the etale-local parameter criterion, not strictness of global components.

proof.text: Stalk-chart surjectivity expresses every log element as a chart monomial times a unit. The chart identifies P with the characteristic, so the nonunit ideal transports to I=(a(p):p nonzero). Apply monoidal ideal contraction for every J. Transport the regular quotient of log regularity along the same ring isomorphism; the quotient is nonzero local because I is contained in m_A. Its regular-ring property therefore gives regular local.

proof.text: Finite generation of P gives finite generation of its group completion and finite dimension after rationalization. Identify the additive and multiplicative group-completion models by their universal maps. With r their rational dimension the characteristic rank is the cast of r, and transporting the log dimension formula yields dim A=dim(A/I)+r. An isomorphism P=N^s induces P^gp=Z^s and rationalization Q^s, giving r=s. For s=0 both dimensions are zero.

lean.statement: theorem logRegular_sharp_local_algebra (X : FineSaturatedLogScheme.{u}) (hlog : X.IsLogRegular) {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (t : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X.scheme) : let R := X.scheme.presheaf.stalk (Scheme.SpecToEquivOfField Ω X.scheme t).1 let A := Scheme.strictHenselizationRing t let P := Additive (X.logStructure.characteristic t) IsFineSaturatedMonoid (Multiplicative P) ∧ (∀ p : P, IsAddUnit p → p = 0) ∧ ∃ (K : Type u) (_ : Field K) (_ : Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K) (_ : IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K) (_ : Algebra R K) (_ : IsScalarTower R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K) (_ : Algebra R A) (_ : IsLocalRing A) (_ : IsNoetherianRing A), Algebra.IsStrictHenselization R K A ∧ ∃ (a : Multiplicative P →* A) (I : Ideal A) (r : ℕ), (∀ p : P, p ≠ 0 → a (Multiplicative.ofAdd p) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) ∧ (∀ J : Set P, (∀ p ∈ J, ∀ q : P, p + q ∈ J) → ∀ p : P, a (Multiplicative.ofAdd p) ∈ Ideal.span ((fun q : P ↦ a (Multiplicative.ofAdd q)) '' J) ↔ p ∈ J) ∧ I = Ideal.span ((fun p : P ↦ a (Multiplicative.ofAdd p)) '' {p | p ≠ 0}) ∧ r = Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[ℤ] Algebra.GrothendieckAddGroup P) ∧ (∀ s : ℕ, Nonempty (P ≃+ (Fin s → ℕ)) → r = s) ∧ IsRegularLocalRing (A ⧸ I) ∧ ringKrullDim A = ringKrullDim (A ⧸ I) + (r : WithBot ℕ∞)
